description: Show the account's verification status, plan, free trial, envelopes used and remaining this period, top-up envelopes, plan features, content_retention_days (how many days after a document is finished its contents are kept before md2sign deletes them), and checkout links if there is no plan yet.

api_key.description: An md2sign API key. When given, this call uses that key's account even if the connection is signed in as someone else, so pass it on every call when your human has more than one md2sign account (for example two businesses). Also use it if your MCP client cannot send an "Authorization: Bearer <api_key>" header.

name: get_account
title: Get account, plan and usage
